edges: Howard Gardner introduced the concept of multiple intelligences.
Howard Gardner identified linguistic intelligence as one of the types of intelligence.
Howard Gardner identified logical-mathematical intelligence as one of the types of intelligence.
Howard Gardner identified spatial intelligence as one of the types of intelligence.
Howard Gardner identified bodily-kinesthetic intelligence as one of the types of intelligence.
Howard Gardner identified musical intelligence as one of the types of intelligence.
Howard Gardner identified interpersonal intelligence as one of the types of intelligence.
Howard Gardner identified intrapersonal intelligence as one of the types of intelligence.
Howard Gardner introduced the concept of multiple intelligences in 1983.
